card.name: Linking words after angioedema and swelling
card.fires_on: Small linking marks right after a medical term, mostly "including" or an opening parenthesis after angioedema or swelling in hypersensitivity lists. It also fires on "with" or "of" inside warning headings.

modes.label: Parenthesis after angioedema
modes.description: The word "including" or "(" that opens a list of body parts affected by swelling.

modes.label: Opening bracket after swelling
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after "swelling" that introduces affected areas such as face, eye, lip.

modes.label: Linking word in headings
modes.description: "with" or "of" inside a condition or warning heading.

card.plain: It marks the small connecting word that introduces a list of details after a swelling or allergy term.
